name: AWS S3
description: Scalable object storage service. S3 event notifications trigger Wnode pipelines on object creation, deletion, or modification, enabling decentralized data processing workflows. Workloads invoked via this integration run on Wnode's Tier 6 DECC/TEE secure enclaves.

endpoints.description: Receive S3 event notification and invoke Wnode pipeline
Generate presigned URL for direct S3 upload/download
